title: Verdicts and reviews
summary: Verdicts automatically link the actual plan execution and concrete artifact ids. A deployment verdict re-evaluates active frozen-target acceptance after commit. An aborted execution stays terminal while its completed captures receive independent verdicts. A recorded verdict batch cancels its review wake. Re-entering the plan runner reprints passing verdicts instead of capturing those requirements again; a failed or undetermined verdict stays open, so re-entry begins a fresh capture. A one-shot pass on a blocking requirement names the tree it verified as `verification_tree.head_sha` in its raw_result JSON; prose is refused because the terminal gate cannot read a commit from it.
